phantasyStar4.head: Head
phantasyStar4.orderHelp: Changes the actual in-game inventory order. Table sorting only changes this view.
phantasyStar4.readonlyHelp: Level, status and equipment are shown for reference. Combat totals are calculated from base attributes and equipment.
phantasyStar4.maxPointsHelp: Supported edited maxima: HP 1–999 and TP 0–999. Lowering a maximum also lowers the current value when needed.
phantasyStar4.maxUsesHelp: Editable maximum: 0–99, matching the game's two-digit counter. Increasing it does not refill remaining uses.
phantasyStar4.fieldModeRequired: Return to a field or menu outside battle, then capture a new checkpoint before changing attributes or abilities.
phantasyStar4.rulesRequiredHelp: Attribute and ability selection editing requires the reviewed Chinese 1.6 Original-mode game data.
phantasyStar4.learningSpaceRequired: Reserve {count} slots for this character's future {ability} from level-ups and story events; fixed event slots can be replaced later by the game.
phantasyStar4.computedHelp: Calculated from base {attribute}; read-only. Equipment: {attributeBonus} ({attribute}) + {combatBonus} ({stat}) = {total}. Edit base {attribute} to update this result.
